decided: At the default settings orbit no longer writes decision records: they are written only when chaining, a sign-off setting or the tripwires are turned on, the three settings that read them, and later the autonomous driver.
alternatives: keep writing them under every setting, as today
keep writing them but stop checking them at the default review
why: At the defaults the only thing that reads the records is a check of the records themselves, while the rule that asks for them fills about a tenth of every workflow body on every turn.

defines.definition: A small file the AI writes when it makes a call in one of eighteen listed areas, or before it stops to ask at one of five listed situations, with the answer recorded beside it.
The setting under which the user signs off a change or a whole program before it is archived or finished.
Checks orbit runs when that setting is on, which stop the work when a change goes past a limit the project set.
